parquet_columns.name: source_captured_at
parquet_columns.timezone: UTC naive; raw basis remains in capture_basis and inventory

source_file_metadata: Retain selected and older capture request/retrieval fields where available in source_metadata_json. No URLs, credentials, or secrets.
capture_selection: Latest hash-verified complete capture per event-date and meet, regardless of year/month/day partition.
identity_rule: Exact official horse ID string matching to core entity_reference_roster where entity_type=horse; no name-based linkage; retain unmatched IDs.
preservation_rules: Keep identical repeats as separate source observations and flag them in QA metadata.
Preserve API22 occurrence order as anonymous storage order; it is not an event ID or event time.
Keep zero, negative, null, blank, and raw delta values unchanged.
All imported rows are retrospective observations with pre-race eligibility unverified.
Do not infer a historical daily 14:00 publication time from current behavior.
Preserve raw meet/venue labels; physical venue remains unadjudicated where unresolved.
